recognize_zh: 周邊血液中兩顆異常前骨髓細胞：右側細胞核呈雙葉（蝴蝶狀），細胞質有密集紫紅色顆粒；左側細胞質帶空泡，箭頭指一顆圓形紫紅色大型包涵體（異常大顆粒，類 Chédiak-Higashi 顆粒）。這些特徵是 APL 的線索。
features: Two large abnormal promyelocytes with abundant cytoplasm
Right cell with bilobed (butterfly-like) nucleus and dense purple azurophilic granules
Left cell with round nucleus, visible nucleoli and vacuolated cytoplasm
Arrow: round reddish-purple cytoplasmic inclusion consistent with a giant abnormal granule (pseudo-Chédiak-Higashi type)
Partial third cell with folded nucleus at lower left
Background red cells including an echinocyte
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows two large abnormal promyelocytes. One has a bilobed, butterfly-shaped nucleus and cytoplasm containing dense purple azurophilic granules, while the other has a round nucleus with nucleoli, vacuolated cytoplasm and a round reddish-purple cytoplasmic inclusion (arrow) consistent with a giant abnormal granule rather than a slender Auer rod. A partially visualized cell with a folded nucleus is present at the lower left. Findings are consistent with acute promyelocytic leukemia; this is a medical emergency, and urgent coagulation studies and PML::RARA confirmation (FISH/RT-PCR) with immediate ATRA are indicated.

ddx.vs: Myeloblasts have fewer granules, round nuclei and occasional single Auer rods, lacking bilobed hypergranular promyelocytes and PML::RARA.
Normal promyelocytes have round eccentric nuclei with a Golgi hof and appear with a full maturing myeloid spectrum, not bilobed nuclei or giant granules.
Monocytic blasts have folded nuclei with grey-blue, finely granular cytoplasm and are NSE-positive with weak MPO, unlike strongly MPO-positive hypergranular APL cells.
Inherited giant granules occur in mature neutrophils and lymphocytes with normal nuclear maturation, not in leukemic promyelocytes.
